page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the instance delivers modest performance across most workloads. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests place the instance in the bottom 25% of its class, which is mirrored by a Geekbench single-core score of 848.0 and a multi-core score of 3291.0. Memory bandwidth performance is mixed; while read-only operations for both small and large blocks fall into the bottom 25%, large block write bandwidth achieves an average rating at 33.29 GB/sec. Similarly, Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests score in the middle 50%, though database operations and Redis SET operations remain in the lower tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2.xlarge offers a dedicated CPU allocation and a balanced resource profile, making it a stable choice for workloads that require predictable CPU access without the premium of high-performance compute or memory-optimized hardware. However, the tradeoff is lower overall processing throughput, as shown by poor single-threaded compression and decompression speeds. This instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads such as moderate web serving, basic application hosting, and lightweight background processing tasks that do not demand high-speed local storage or intensive parallel processing.
